# Psalm 38 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A psalm of David, for the memorial offering.

**2** O LORD, rebuke me not in Your anger, nor discipline me in Your wrath!

**3** For Your arrows have sunk into me, and Your hand has come down on me.

**4** There is no soundness in my flesh because of Your indignation; there is no health in my bones because of my sin.

**5** For my iniquities have gone over my head; like a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

**6** My wounds stink and fester because of my foolishness,

**7** I am utterly bowed down and prostrate; all the day I go about mourning.

**8** For my sides are filled with burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.

**9** I am feeble and crushed; I groan because of the tumult of my heart.

**10** O Lord, all my longing is before You; my sighing is not hidden from You.

**11** My heart throbs; my strength fails me, and the light of my eyes — it also has gone from me.

**12** My friends and companions stand aloof from my plague, and my nearest kin stand far off.

**13** Those who seek my life lay their snares; those who seek my hurt speak of ruin and meditate treachery all day long.

**14** But I am like a deaf man; I do not hear, like a mute man who does not open his mouth.

**15** I have become like a man who does not hear, and in whose mouth are no rebuttals.

**16** But for You, O LORD, do I wait; it is You, O Lord my God, who will answer.

**17** For I said, 'Only let them not rejoice over me, who boast against me when my foot slips!'

**18** For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever before me.

**19** I confess my iniquity; I am sorry for my sin.

**20** But my foes are vigorous; they are mighty, and many are those who hate me wrongfully.

**21** Those who render me evil for good accuse me because I follow after good.

**22** Do not forsake me, O LORD! O my God, be not far from me!

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

- **38:14-15**: Deliberate silence before accusers — the psalmist chooses not to defend himself, trusting God to answer instead. Cf. Isaiah 53:7.

— LOGOS
